properties.name: Axe
properties.description: The murder weapon Raskolnikov used for the crime. He took it from the kitchen of his lodging house. It was used to kill both Alyona and Lizaveta.

properties.name: Silver Watch
properties.description: A keepsake from Raskolnikov's late father. It has an engraving of a globe on the back cover. The first item he brings to Alyona's to pawn.

properties.name: Ring
properties.description: A ring Raskolnikov pawned with Alyona. He mutters about it in his feverish delirium, which becomes a clue in the investigation.

properties.name: Purse (Stolen Money)
properties.description: The purse and valuables Raskolnikov stole from Alyona's room after the murder. He never uses them and keeps them hidden under a stone.

properties.name: Mother's Letter
properties.description: A long letter sent to Raskolnikov by Pulkheria. It announces Dunya's engagement to Luzhin and becomes the psychological trigger for Raskolnikov's actions.

properties.name: Article 'On Crime'
properties.description: An article written by Raskolnikov during his time as a student and published in a periodical. It develops the 'superman' theory that extraordinary individuals are permitted to commit crimes. Porfiry uses it as a starting point for his interrogation.

properties.name: New Testament
properties.description: A Russian-language New Testament passed from Lizaveta to Sonya. An old, well-worn leather cover. At Raskolnikov's request, Sonya reads him the passage about the raising of Lazarus.

properties.name: Cross
properties.description: Two crosses — one of cypress wood and one of brass — given to Raskolnikov by Sonya just before he turns himself in. A symbol of atonement and rebirth.

properties.name: Three Thousand Rubles
properties.description: The sum bequeathed to Dunya in Marfa's will. Svidrigailov uses it as a pretext to approach Dunya. It is later used for the upkeep of the children and other purposes.

properties.name: Pistol
properties.description: The pistol Dunya produces and fires at Svidrigailov when held captive. The shot misses and Svidrigailov releases her. He later uses it to take his own life.

properties.name: Thirty-Five Rubles (Money from Mother)
properties.description: A money order sent to the bedridden Raskolnikov by Pulkheria through Vakhrushev. It becomes his last source of funds before he turns himself in.
